'''Frangawl cult leader''' was a title held by the leader of the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was held by [[High Seneschal/Legends|High Seneschal]] [[Peteen/Legends|Peteen]] of the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters']] [[Bahk-tov Council/Legends|Bahk-tov Council]].<ref name="Episode Guide I" />
